name: Drutopia Page
description: Config-only Features module that ships a Basic 'Page' content type, its fields (summary, paragraph body builder, meta tags, body), Display Suite form/view displays, a pathauto URL pattern, an RDF mapping, and role permission grants; part of the Drutopia distribution and the recommended replacement for drutopia_landing_page.
project_description: Drutopia Page is a base feature (Features bundle 'drutopia') of the Drutopia distribution and the recommended replacement for the deprecated drutopia_landing_page. It is a config-only module: it ships no PHP, routes, services, hooks, or permissions of its own. Installing it imports a Basic 'page' node type for static content (such as an 'About us' page) together with its fields (a required Summary, a Paragraphs-based body builder in field_body_paragraph labelled 'Description', a Metatag field, and a hidden Body field), a Display Suite form display and default/full/teaser view displays, a pathauto pattern that aliases pages to [node:title], a promote base-field override, an RDF WebPage mapping, and config actions that grant page create/edit permissions to the Drutopia contributor/editor/manager roles. Installed here as a dev checkout (info.yml has no version line); the version directory tracks the 2.0.x dev branch. It carries the Drutopia dependency chain (drutopia_core, drutopia_seo, plus ds, entity_reference_revisions, paragraphs, metatag, pathauto, menu_ui, rdf, text) and is normally installed through the distribution rather than standalone.
